# B&B Cuore di Bosco

> B&B Cuore di Bosco is a bed and breakfast run by its owners in Prada di Brentonico, Trentino, Italy, at 776 m above sea level at the turn-off for Polsa. It stands on the Brentonico Plateau, in Monte Baldo Nature Park, near Rovereto and Lake Garda. It has two rooms, Lampone and Mirtillo, breakfast included, and a baby kit for families. The website is available in Italian, English and German.

## Facts

- Address: Via Gardesani, 15, 38060 Prada di Brentonico (TN), Italy. Altitude: 776 m.
- Location: Brentonico Plateau, Vallagarina, Monte Baldo Nature Park, at the turn-off for Polsa. The Cammino di San Rocco passes in front of the house, and the B&B is one of its official rest stops.
- Rooms: two, Lampone and Mirtillo. Breakfast is included. Free Wi-Fi.
- Families: baby kit with changing table, high chair and more, available for guests with children.
- Bikes are lent free to guests. A laundry service is done by the owners on request.
- Parking: free public parking a few minutes from the house, by the church and at the end of the street. Guests are asked not to park on the street in front of the house.
- Without a car: bus B305 Saccone-Brentonico-Mori-Rovereto stops at the entrance of Prada. The nearest railway station is Rovereto.
- Distances by car: Polsa 10 minutes, San Giacomo 15, San Valentino 20, Rovereto 25, Lake Garda about 30.
- Check-in from 15:00. Check-out by 10:30.
- CIN: IT022025C1W3ZHJVK4
- Phone: +393494960228
- E-mail: info@cuoredibosco.it
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bbcuoredibosco/
